For my 🇧🇷 Brazil house I need to get a guy to come do the electric wiring etc

I also wanna have Home Assistant working

In Portugal the house came with KNX, then I bought a little box that made KNX work with Home Assistant, but KNX seems like a European system only

What system do you suggest for Brazil? Any companies that are legit? This would be in Parana

Essential it works with @home_assistant
posts.text_zh:
为我在巴西 🇧🇷 的房子，我需要找人来做电线铺设等电气工程

我也想把 Home Assistant 用起来

你们会建议巴西用什么系统？有靠谱的公司吗？地点是巴拉那（Parana）

关键是必须能和 @home_assistant 配合使用
